full_name: ECOsystem Spaceborne Thermal Radiometer Experiment on Space Station
access_system: NASA AppEEARS (Application for Extracting and Exploring Analysis Ready Samples)

analysis_window.rationale: April–June captures early alpine growing season onset and peak spring greenup. Constrained by ECOSTRESS overpass availability and snow-free conditions at lower elevations.

temporal_coverage.note: 2025 is partial. Complete seasons: 2019–2023. 2024 has reduced coverage for ET/ESI.

quality_filtering.method: Area-of-interest aggregation via AppEEARS polygon extraction

processing_pipeline: Research prototype — not peer reviewed. Exploratory analysis only.
citation_note: Data accessed via NASA AppEEARS. ECOSTRESS mission: NASA/JPL. Processing by [researcher]. Cite data products individually if publishing.
